title: [dynamo] Add most recent bytecode/Python stack context to graph break developer error context
bug_description:
Log the last k (k = 50?) bytecode instructions traced, along with the state of the symbolic Python stack.

i.e. print the last k outputs of `TORCH_LOGS=trace_bytecode` when logging a graph break.

For example,
```python
import torch


@torch.compile(backend="eager")
def fn(x):
    y = x + 1
    z = x + y
    torch._dynamo.graph_break()
    return z


fn(torch.ones(3))
```

Would have these instructions logged into the graph break message:
```
Graph break in user code at /data/users/williamwen/pytorch/playground3.py:8
Graph Break Reason: Call to `torch._dynamo.graph_break()`
  Explanation: User-inserted graph break. Message: None
  Hint: Remove the `torch._dynamo.graph_break()` call.

  Developer debug context: Called `torch._dynamo.graph_break()` with args `[]`, kwargs `{}`
  Most recent 50 bytecode instructions traced:
    RESUME 0 []
    LOAD_FAST x []
    LOAD_CONST 1 [LazyVariableTracker()]
    BINARY_OP 0 [LazyVariableTracker(), ConstantVariable(int: 1)]
    STORE_FAST y [TensorVariable()]
    LOAD_FAST x []
    LOAD_FAST y [TensorVariable()]
    BINARY_OP 0 [TensorVariable(), TensorVariable()]
    STORE_FAST z [TensorVariable()]
    LOAD_GLOBAL torch []
    LOAD_ATTR _dynamo [LazyVariableTracker()]
    LOAD_ATTR graph_break [LazyVariableTracker()]
    CALL 0 [LazyVariableTracker(), NullVariable]

 For more details about this graph break, please visit: https://meta-pytorch.github.io/compile-graph-break-site/gb/gb0025.html
User code traceback:
  File "/data/users/williamwen/pytorch/playground3.py", line 12, in <module>
    fn(torch.ones(3))
  File "/data/users/williamwen/pytorch/playground3.py", line 8, in fn
    torch._dynamo.graph_break()
```

Including bytecode source attribution to the logged VariableTrackers (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/162857) would make this debug information even more helpful.
